findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "start_deep_analysis" is 627 chars, far longer than this server's median (80). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_deep_thread, feedback_list · Private data: get_account · Public sink: create_webhook, delete_webhook, test_webhook, send_feedback, quote_post, sectors_follow, webhooks_get · Destructive: quick_read, start_live_session, list_live_sessions, get_live_session, get_updates, run_live_analysis, get_live_analysis, watch_news, delete_webhook, start_deep_analysis, get_deep_analysis, ask_deep_analysis, get_deep_thread, create_autopilot, run_autopilot_agent, sectors_unfollow, deep_events, deep_stop, deep_resume, autopilots_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_deep_thread, feedback_list · Private data: get_account · Public sink: create_webhook, delete_webhook, test_webhook, send_feedback, quote_post, sectors_follow, webhooks_get · Destructive: quick_read, start_live_session, list_live_sessions, get_live_session, get_updates, run_live_analysis, get_live_analysis, watch_news, delete_webhook, start_deep_analysis, get_deep_analysis, ask_deep_analysis, get_deep_thread, create_autopilot, run_autopilot_agent, sectors_unfollow, deep_events, deep_stop, deep_resume, autopilots_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
